{"reason":"Change the medium/high fallback action from suggest-alternative-supplier to alert-planner. Each of the 34 supplier-switch rows saves 10,000 (35,000 versus 45,000), while alert-planner always arrives in time, so stockouts cannot rise and the cited 5.3- and 2.8-day stockout failures are prevented. Current cost is 2,165,000 with four stockouts.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
      (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
      (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
